correctness.rationale: Every proper cover must include 1 or 2 marked 1s; alignment of the first and last occurrence forces its length, yielding at most one cover of each kind. For p,d,e,c as defined, 1-one case iff p,c<min(d,e), max(d,e)≤p+c+1, and 2-one iff d=e, p,c<d. Counting these gap quadruples yields A(z),B(z), and C(z) as explicit rational sums; inclusion-exclusion yields F₂=C,F₁=A+B−2C,F₀=z³/(1−z)^4−A−B+C. Root-of-unity singularity comparison yields Pr(q>0)→1/90, Pr(q=2)~1/(12n). Independently enumerated every three-one word through length 16; all cover lengths/counts matched. Infinite case rests on gap bijections and rational-function argument.
